design: Certificates for each campus and stratum computed from data dated 2016 or earlier, either from the peers' history (double nesting, script 45's gates) or from the campus's own history with calendar years as contexts, with the screen and with the prior-year count rule as the score; each is checked against the top-decile lift the screen realizes on the campus in 2017 to 2019.

definitions.calendar: year = period_q // 4; history year <= 2016; evaluation 2017 <= year <= 2019
definitions.history_labels: a history row at quarter t carries the label of quarter t+1, so the last history labels describe 2017 Q1; evaluation labels start at 2017 Q2, so the two windows share no labelled quarter
definitions.local_contexts: calendar years, passed to gates_for as the context column
definitions.rule_score: upm_cnt_w4 on the same rows; labels of the corresponding model arm
definitions.realized: top-decile lift of f_h^(-c) within (c, k), 2017-2019, evaluable with >= 10 positives and >= 100 rows; holds when lift >= 2
definitions.certified: S >= 0.67; no verdict when the stratum has < 20 positives or < 200 rows
definitions.wilson_95: Wilson score interval for the share that holds

skipped.reason: degenerate split (no positives to learn or to score)

pair.skipped: degenerate split (no positives to learn or to score)

reproduction_vs_temporal_louo.note: rows and positives of each campus's evaluation window equal temporal_louo.json exactly (asserted); lifts differ only by the training device (CPU here)
